cases.name: Nicole Gabrek
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Amongst spending quality time with friends and family, Nicole enjoyed her home in Kissimmee, Florida, and the abundance of amusement parks and attractions, as she was an avid park merchandise collector. When not putting her family before herself, her spare time was spent on FaceTiming the grandkids, working with her sticker books, coloring, completing puzzles, and simply relaxing with a cosmo.

As a beloved wife, mother, daughter, sister, and the ultimate friend to all of those who knew her personally, she will be remembered by her never-ending giving heart, an abundance of patience, warm hospitality, humanity and generous nature."
